description:
Pick which time slots to charge in so the car has the energy it needs at the lowest cost. Runs on the
CVaR-QAOA quantum simulator and against exact search; the signed receipt shows both and the plan is the proven
best. Returns the slots, cost, and savings over charging right away. A plan only: nothing is sent to a charger.

energy_needed_kwh.description: Energy to add before departure, in kWh
energy_needed_kwh.title: Energy Needed Kwh

price_per_kwh.description: Electricity price for each time slot before departure (2-16 slots)
price_per_kwh.title: Price Per Kwh

slot_hours.description: Length of one slot in hours (default 1)
slot_hours.title: Slot Hours

switch_penalty_usd.description: Cost charged for each start/stop, to favor one continuous session (default 0)
switch_penalty_usd.title: Switch Penalty Usd
